label: Collection of accounts receivable
notes: Not revenue: reduces a receivable already recognised.

label: Savings / time deposit withdrawal
notes: Reduces the liability owed to the member. Not an expense.

label: Loan released to member
member_effect: Adds to the member loan balance
notes: Asset: money the member owes the cooperative. Chosen as Loan Payable on the form and posted to Loan Receivable.

label: Charge sales
notes: Revenue. Use Account Receivable as the debit when no cash is received.

label: Time deposit placement
notes: Not revenue: a liability owed to the member. Savings and time deposits share one account in the current chart.

label: Savings deposit
notes: Not revenue: a liability owed to the member.

label: Payment of accounts payable
notes: Not an expense: settles a payable already recognised.
